 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Scott Malpass. Scott was the CIO of Notre Dame's endowment for 32 years, and has always been a pioneer at the forefront of the endowment investing world. Leading Notre Dame's early investments into Sequoia, as well as some of the premier fund managers in China decades ago.
